statement: WITH base AS (SELECT channel_id, topic_categories FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_channel_labels_20260612 WHERE topic_category_count > 0), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id) AS n_nonempty_channels FROM base), group_presence_raw AS (SELECT channel_id, 'Lifestyle_(sociology)' AS group_label, 'direct_parent' AS group_role FROM base WHERE array_contains(topic_categories, 'Lifestyle_(sociology)') UNION ALL SELECT channel_id, 'Entertainment' AS group_label, 'direct_parent' AS group_role FROM base WHERE array_contains(topic_categories, 'Entertainment') UNION ALL SELECT channel_id, 'Music_combined' AS group_label, 'lumped_music' AS group_role FROM base WHERE size(array_intersect(topic_categories, array('Music','Christian_music','Classical_music','Country_music','Electronic_music','Hip_hop_music','Independent_music','Jazz','Music_of_Asia','Music_of_Latin_America','Pop_music','Reggae','Rhythm_and_blues','Rock_music','Soul_music'))) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT channel_id, 'Video_game_combined' AS group_label, 'lumped_video_game' AS group_role FROM base WHERE size(array_intersect(topic_categories, array('Video_game_culture','Action_game','Action-adventure_game','Casual_game','Music_video_game','Puzzle_video_game','Racing_video_game','Role-playing_video_game','Simulation_video_game','Sports_game','Strategy_video_game'))) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT channel_id, 'Sport' AS group_label, 'direct_parent' AS group_role FROM base WHERE array_contains(topic_categories, 'Sport') UNION ALL SELECT channel_id, 'Vehicle' AS group_label, 'direct_parent_like' AS group_role FROM base WHERE array_contains(topic_categories, 'Vehicle')), group_presence AS (SELECT DISTINCT channel_id, group_label, group_role FROM group_presence_raw), group_counts AS (SELECT p.group_label, p.group_role, COUNT(DISTINCT p.channel_id) AS n_group_channels, MAX(t.n_nonempty_channels) AS n_nonempty_channels, COUNT(DISTINCT p.channel_id) / MAX(t.n_nonempty_channels) AS group_prevalence FROM group_presence p CROSS JOIN totals t GROUP BY p.group_label, p.group_role), qualified AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY group_prevalence DESC, group_label) AS prevalence_rank FROM group_counts WHERE group_prevalence > 0.02), group_pairs AS (SELECT a.channel_id, a.group_label AS group_a, b.group_label AS group_b FROM group_presence a INNER JOIN group_presence b ON a.channel_id = b.channel_id), pair_counts AS (SELECT qa.group_label AS group_a, qb.group_label AS group_b, COUNT(DISTINCT gp.channel_id) AS n_both_channels FROM qualified qa CROSS JOIN qualified qb LEFT JOIN group_pairs gp ON qa.group_label = gp.group_a AND qb.group_label = gp.group_b GROUP BY qa.group_label, qb.group_label) SELECT qa.prevalence_rank AS row_rank, qb.prevalence_rank AS col_rank, qa.group_label AS label_a, qb.group_label AS label_b, qa.group_role AS role_a, qb.group_role AS role_b, qa.n_nonempty_channels AS denominator_channels, qa.n_group_channels AS n_a_channels, qb.n_group_channels AS n_b_channels, pc.n_both_channels, qa.group_prevalence AS prevalence_a, qb.group_prevalence AS prevalence_b, pc.n_both_channels / qa.n_nonempty_channels AS joint_prevalence, pc.n_both_channels / qa.n_group_channels AS conditional_b_given_a, pc.n_both_channels / qb.n_group_channels AS conditional_a_given_b, pc.n_both_channels / (qa.n_group_channels + qb.n_group_channels - pc.n_both_channels) AS jaccard, (pc.n_both_channels / qa.n_nonempty_channels) / NULLIF(qa.group_prevalence * qb.group_prevalence, 0) AS lift_vs_independence FROM qualified qa CROSS JOIN qualified qb INNER JOIN pair_counts pc ON qa.group_label = pc.group_a AND qb.group_label = pc.group_b ORDER BY qa.prevalence_rank, qb.prevalence_rank
